name: DGX Spark Inkling 2 Mini Atlas (SparkInkling 0.5.1)

weights.description: Which weights the engine serves: spark (the default) adds SparkInkling's calibrated NVFP4 overlay for decode; strict is the checkpoint as shipped.

strict.description: Thinking Machines' checkpoint as shipped (NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, MXFP8 in 20-23, BF16 attention, router and vocabulary head).

spark.description: Strict plus Enntity/Inkling-2-Mini-Spark-NVFP4 (2.9 GB): calibrated NVFP4 attention projections, vocabulary head and layer 20-23 experts. Next-token KL 0.0081 to Strict on 224 held-out documents (97.0% top-1 agreement).

summary: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini on one DGX Spark with SparkInkling 0.5.1's Atlas build: incoai's DFlash2 drafter, window-bounded KV with requests of up to 1048576 tokens (786432 in the saver mode), prefix caching. --weights spark (default) adds a calibrated NVFP4 overlay; --weights strict serves the checkpoint as shipped. Three modes: default (8 requests), saver (8 requests at half the GPU memory) and max (32 requests). Additive only: no default model, no aliases.
description: This recipe installs SparkInkling 0.5.1 at the immutable product revision recorded in backends/atlas-sparkinkling/pins-0.5.1.json. The Atlas engine image is built from Enntity/sparkinkling by install/build.sh and published to GHCR; LLooM commits no engine source. Setup acquires thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2 (sha256-checked) and, with --weights spark, Enntity/Inkling-2-Mini-Spark-NVFP4 (sha256-checked) at pinned revisions, pulls the image by its manifest digest and verifies it, then runs SparkInkling's own install/check_files.py and spark_overlay.py, fetched at the pinned revision, digest-checked and run inside the image with no network: they check the checkpoint's, drafter's and overlay's weights against their pinned sha256 and, with --weights spark, assemble the Spark model directory beside the checkpoint. Setup remembers the weights it installed with.

provenance.source: SparkInkling 0.5.1: Enntity/sparkinkling a05e7fa10d33f17bbcc45f1d8776299d732afcea (main, tag v0.5.1, released 2026-11-27; install tree a96a89ab0b293c597474f0c402caf8ed968d0034), engine Enntity/atlas inkling2/rc-0.5.1-20261126 @ a4dbba37810ff4e54ece0a072aae77af69bb836d (AGPL-3.0-only, recorded in the image's /opt/atlas/source-manifest.json). Image ghcr.io/enntity/atlas-sparkinkling:a96a89ab0b29 (also :0.5.1), addressed by its GHCR manifest digest. Profiles default.json (0.80 GPU memory utilization, 8 sequences, 1048576 tokens), saver.json (0.50, 8, 786432) and max.json (0.85, 32, 1048576), all with BF16 KV (window-bounded), 8192-token prefill chunks and prefix caching. Model thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini revision ed40e7da625f594fc9c4990f5f66be24873c22d7 (Apache-2.0); drafter incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2 @ 4f9088ea66c21f2b99ed657d1941c306b03e84d2 (Apache-2.0); overlay Enntity/Inkling-2-Mini-Spark-NVFP4 @ e9df93dceea2fbf0927caf178104e868452a6292 (Apache-2.0).

hardware.testedMachine: One DGX Spark with 128 GB unified memory
notes: This version pins SparkInkling 0.5.1 (engine a4dbba378): the same model, drafter and overlay as 0.5.0 on a faster engine. Prefill attention's relative bias runs on the tensor cores with per-head flash prefill, the prefill norms, conv residuals and loop-message gates are fused, the experts' SwiGLU and its quantization run in the gate_up GEMM's epilogue, and the large projections use CUTLASS BF16 tiles; a prompt that arrives while others decode runs one prefill chunk a tick, and the profiles use 8,192-token chunks (was 4,096). Spark decode's projections run on row-invariant tensor-core kernels, and both weights now draft three each for two live requests. --weights spark is the default; the engine carries an opt-in LoopCD (SPARKINKLING_LOOPCD) that this recipe leaves off. Versions 4 (0.5.0 republished), 3 (0.5.0, first image), 2 (0.4.2) and 1 (0.4.1) stay installable by number.

SparkInkling 0.5.1 on one GB10, 2026-11-27, SparkModelBench 293a44f (RigMark protocol 1.3.0 and RigMark Quality v0.0.2, low reasoning effort, temperature 0), default profile and DFlash2 drafter, nothing else serving; medians. Spark: code 88.2, prose 57.0, structured 129.9 tok/s; cold prefill 5,174 / 5,024 / 4,540 / 3,781 / 2,824 tok/s at 8K / 32K / 64K / 128K / 256K; code aggregate at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 requests 63.2 / 81.9 / 104.7 / 144.1. Strict: code 68.7, prose 40.2, structured 102.3; cold prefill 5,137 / 4,918 / 4,481 / 3,779 / 2,827; 48.1 / 65.6 / 85.6 / 126.4. Decode gates 15/15 and RigMark Quality 3/4 (go-transfer-ledger misses its acceptance check) in both modes. Cold 32K prefill is 1.53x 0.5.0's (Spark) and 1.50x (Strict); decode workloads differ from 0.5.0's RigMark 1.1.0 run, so decode is not compared. SparkModelBench's staggered four-request lane does not apply: it asks for thinking off, which Inkling 2 Mini does not have. vLLM was not measured with SparkModelBench; 0.5.0's comparison on RigMark 1.1.0 is in version 4's notes. Receipts: Enntity/sparkinkling results/2026-11-27-rc-0.5.1.

The 0.5.1 image build ran the engine's CPU workspace suite (8,861 tests passed) and Clippy. On the image, in both modes: a task probe (30 arithmetic word problems, 10 single-tool calls) passed 30/30 and 10/10; tool calls came back as calls blocking and streamed, with thinking on and off and with a forced tool choice; a call to a blocked address finished content_filter, streamed when asked and with no arguments sent when not; an invoice image was transcribed exactly and a 3x3 labelled colour grid read 9/9; greedy text with the drafter on at one, two and four requests matched text with it off, 8/8. Smoke-level checks, not a qualification.

Profiles: default 8 requests of up to 1,048,576 tokens at 0.80 GPU memory utilization (KV pool 1,909,536 tokens Strict, 1,790,944 Spark); saver 8 x 786,432 at 0.50 (882,992 / 741,520); max 32 x 1,048,576 at 0.85 (1,872,512 / 1,718,048). The 8,192-token prefill buffer costs 2-9% of the pool against 0.5.0. Two full-length requests are not resident together; requests the pool cannot hold yet wait rather than fail. On 0.5.0, whose KV layout this is, a code hidden a third of the way into a 1,032,929-token prompt was recalled in Spark mode (1,253 s for the request).

Peak host memory was not measured per mode. LLooM reserves an estimate: saver 66 GB, default 104 GB, max 110 GB. The container is capped at 114 GiB because a GB10 that runs out of shared memory hangs instead of killing a process. In the default and max modes little else should use this Spark's GPU memory.

The engine serves 127.0.0.1:8895 (fixed by the image) with host networking. Text and image input (OpenAI image_url parts with base64 data URIs; one image token per 40x40 pixel tile, no resize); no video.

Licenses: the Atlas engine and SparkInkling's install tools run from the image and are AGPL-3.0-only (not included in LLooM). thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2 and Enntity/Inkling-2-Mini-Spark-NVFP4 are Apache-2.0; the drafter's and overlay's READMEs are kept beside their weights for attribution.

steps.title: Verify the SparkInkling pin manifest is final
Acquire the pinned Inkling 2 Mini checkpoint
Acquire incoai's DFlash2 drafter for Inkling 2 Mini
Pull or verify the pinned SparkInkling image
Check the weights and the DFlash2 drafter, and assemble the ${weightsTitle} model directory
Create the persistent CUDA JIT cache directory

modes.summary: Profile saver: 8 requests of up to 786432 tokens, 0.50 GPU memory utilization, 66 GB reserved; leaves room for sidecars.
Profile default: 8 requests of up to 1048576 tokens, 0.80 GPU memory utilization, 104 GB reserved.
